title: 1996 The X Files Season 2 Topps Trading Card #64 Episode: Little Green Men
descriptionText: The product is a 1996 Topps trading card #64 from the X-Files Season 2. This non-sport trading card features an episode titled "Little Green Men" from the popular TV series. With its collectible nature and ties to the X-Files franchise, this card appeals to fans of the show looking to add a piece of memorabilia from the series to their collection.
